symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1 in VLAN 30
show_outputs:
GigabitEthernet0/0.10 is up, line protocol is up
GigabitEthernet0/0.30 is administratively down, line protocol is down
expected_fault: VLAN 30 router sub-interface is administratively down
expected_fix: no shutdown on VLAN 30 sub-interface

symptom: PC in VLAN 20 cannot communicate with another VLAN
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
20  SALES  active
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 switchport access vlan 30
expected_fault: Access port is assigned to VLAN 30 instead of VLAN 20
expected_fix: switchport access vlan 20

symptom: PC gets IP but cannot reach its gateway
show_outputs:
PC IP: 192.168.10.25/24
Default Gateway: 192.168.20.1
Router interface: 192.168.10.1/24
expected_fault: Default gateway is in the wrong subnet
expected_fix: ipconfig / show ip interface brief

DHCP Server: 0.0.0.0
show ip dhcp pool
No addresses leased

expected_fix: show ip dhcp pool; show ip dhcp binding
